title: Servicing a press before the weekend

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Can the press run through Saturday? The maintenance calendar says its oil change isn't due until Tuesday.
turns.zh: 這台沖床可以運轉到星期六結束嗎？保養行事曆寫著下星期二才需要換油。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Tuesday was our estimate, based on normal use. We added a night shift, so the press will reach its service limit by Friday evening. We go by operating hours, not the date on the calendar.
turns.zh: 星期二是照平常用量估算的。我們加開了夜班，所以沖床到星期五晚上就會達到保養時數上限。我們要看運轉時數，不是看行事曆上的日期。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Can maintenance come right after the Friday afternoon shift? We don't need the press again until Saturday morning.
turns.zh: 維護人員能在星期五午班結束後馬上過來嗎？那之後到星期六早上才會再用到沖床。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I'll ask. The spare oil has arrived, but the old oil has to cool before they drain it. Let me find out how long that takes.
turns.zh: 我會去問。換油用的新油到了，但舊油要先冷卻才能排掉。我先確認要等多久。

維護協調人員：星期二是照平常用量估算的。我們加開了夜班，所以沖床到星期五晚上就會達到保養時數上限。我們要看運轉時數，不是看行事曆上的日期。

audioScript:
Can the press run through Saturday? The maintenance calendar says its oil change isn't due until Tuesday.
Tuesday was our estimate, based on normal use. We added a night shift, so the press will reach its service limit by Friday evening. We go by operating hours, not the date on the calendar.
Can maintenance come right after the Friday afternoon shift? We don't need the press again until Saturday morning.
I'll ask. The spare oil has arrived, but the old oil has to cool before they drain it. Let me find out how long that takes.
